instruction.name: revb.4h
instruction.description: Reverse the bytes within each of the four 16-bit halfwords.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 65536, iters 153.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: revb.4h $r12, $r4; revb.4h $r13, $r5; revb.4h $r14, $r6; revb.4h $r15, $r7; revb.4h $r16, $r8; revb.4h $r17, $r9; revb.4h $r18, $r10; revb.4h $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'revb.4h $r12, $r4; revb.4h $r13, $r5; revb.4h $r14, $r6; revb.4h $r15, $r7; revb.4h $r16, $r8; revb.4h $r17, $r9; revb.4h $r18, $r10; revb.4h $r19, $r11'
